nodes.label: Producer applications
nodes.summary: Sends records to a topic. Key hash picks the partition, so one key keeps its order. Idempotent by default (enable.idempotence=true, acks=all).

nodes.label: Partition leader (broker)
nodes.summary: Appends to the partition's log and serves reads. One leader per partition. Followers fetch from it.
nodes.details: A partition is an ordered, append-only log and the unit of ordering and parallelism.

nodes.label: Follower replicas
nodes.summary: Hot standbys that fetch from the leader. Those caught up form the ISR. A record is committed once every ISR member has applied it.
nodes.details: With acks=all the leader waits for the full ISR. min.insync.replicas (default 1) sets the minimum that must acknowledge. unclean.leader.election.enable defaults to false: favour consistency over availability.

nodes.label: KRaft controller quorum
nodes.summary: Raft quorum that stores cluster metadata and elects partition leaders. Fences brokers that miss heartbeats (session timeout default 9 s, heartbeat every 2 s).
nodes.details: Kafka 4.0 (2025-03-18) is the first major release that operates entirely without ZooKeeper.

nodes.label: Group coordinator
nodes.summary: A broker that tracks consumer-group membership, assigns partitions and stores committed offsets. Consumers never talk to each other.
nodes.details: Each partition is consumed by exactly one member of a consumer group at a time. KIP-848's new consumer protocol is GA in 4.0 as an opt-in (group.protocol=consumer).

nodes.label: Consumer applications
nodes.summary: Members poll their assigned partitions at their own pace (pull model). Add members up to the partition count, or add groups to re-read the same data independently.
nodes.details: Pull model: a slow consumer "simply falls behind and catches up when it can".

nodes.label: Tiered storage (remote)
nodes.summary: Hot data stays on broker disks. Rolled segments are copied to object storage such as S3. Old reads are served from the remote tier.
nodes.details: KIP-405, marked production-ready since Kafka 3.9. Pluggable RemoteStorageManager.

steps.caption: The producer sends a record to the leader of its partition. The key hash chose the partition.
The leader appends to its log and followers fetch the new data.
Followers in the ISR confirm. With acks=all the leader waits for the full ISR, and rejects the write if fewer than min.insync.replicas are available.

flows.name: Join a consumer group and read

steps.caption: A consumer joins the group and heartbeats to the group coordinator broker.
The coordinator assigns it partitions. Each partition goes to exactly one member of the group.
The consumer pulls from each partition leader. Only committed records (replicated to the ISR) are visible.
The active controller notices the broker missed heartbeats and fences it. A new leader is elected from the ISR for each affected partition.
Producers retry against the new leader. The idempotent producer's sequence numbers stop the retry from duplicating records.
Rolled segments are copied asynchronously to remote object storage, so local retention can be short.
A consumer that rewinds beyond local retention is served from the remote tier.
